recommended_sequence: Freeze the current unknown-rights corpus as its own private partition and preserve its hashes.
Ingest MusicBrainz canonical metadata for stable artist/work/recording IDs and cross-source dedupe.
Add item-cleared Tier A text through official bulk feeds, starting with Gutenberg and public-domain songbooks.
Request DALI access and admit records only after its grant and license text are saved with the snapshot.
Use WASABI for metadata and annotations; do not count it as 1.73M downloadable full lyrics.
Recompute unique token totals after every source snapshot before choosing the 150M or 300M model.
